items.note: S2.1 states the lemma (y_S+=x_S for arbitrary scratch; three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring scratch) and its method/motivation follow the paper's route (8-row schedule cancelling old scratch, side wires correcting intersection coefficients, composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x)). Missing are the net map (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, the neighbour rules and h=100, N, m.

S2.2 states the common-frame commutation and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, with edge operators D_vD_u^{-1}; it is a single infer step, so the invariant argument is not shown as a derivation.

Nested nondegenerate labels from triple indicators and the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, losing h) are stated, with L<N/2. The budget sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are absent, and the 'count' method has no sub-steps for the bilinear form, neighbour orthogonality or the label table.

Projections P_U at vertices, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, endpoint difference I_m and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm are stated correctly. The derivation skips the key fact rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the rank-one exception 2P_{U_a} on the N source edges.

S2.5 states one translation kernel aI+bX_v per residual basis vector and telescoping to C^{tensor m} on every role. It omits the phase frames C_U, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, the diagonal corrections and the k-column version.
s<Wm, s_b<W_bm and L<N/2 are stated, and S3.2.4 uses s/W<m^tau. The deficits eta_b, eta_c, the value tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} and the log m<20 argument are absent, and s_c<W_cm is not stated separately.

The O(V) digit permutations, moves, split/merge and cyclic row splitting, and the controlled shift y->y+a mod q^b with rational units, are stated. S1.2 drops the conditions: offset preparable in b^{O(1)} time, q prime, denominators prime to q.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V) are stated correctly, with the paper's route (triangular parts by controlled shifts, one interchange per one of Pi). Missing: the elimination proof of the factorization, the choice of the prime q, and how H_i<-H_i+D_j becomes one interchange (D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j).

Follows the paper's proof: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on every edge giving H<-H+D on every row, three shears, recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^tau giving O(e^tau), and the depth-first parking schedule. 'Enough rows' loosens the hypothesis that the row field length is divisible by W^k.
The O(Vu^tau) interchange (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) for arbitrary widths is stated. The reduction (high digits as rows, padding, base-m pieces) is not given.

S4.2 states s_c child calls on f=e/m axes giving C^{tensor e}, and S4.1 gives H_0=bSCS. The conjugation by P_M that puts kernels on slots, the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, the fixed number of row additions and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D are all absent.

S4.3 states the right operation (XOR of corresponding selected bits, a third chunk as temporary, cyclic shifts plus deterministic repair) and the cost O(V(L^tau+1)). The selected positions j_i=rho+iK, the restoration of the third chunk, the bad-set fraction delta_bad and the full time bound are missing.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the result O(d^{lambda'}) are stated. The leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the q_0 row chunks, the base-m pieces and the conditions on lambda' are missing.

The sub-steps follow the paper's proof: phase identity to a C layer, the network with s_c children on row-split streams, packed basis changes, the recurrence to O(Vd^{lambda'}), exact guarded evaluation with Delta=o(p), and a single final truncation with error <sqrt2 2^{-p} in the disk. Only the uniform-cost check of the packed lemma is not shown.

F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the bit-reversed procedures B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the layout L and the cost are stated. The per-procedure error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and omega_t=y^{2r/t}'s role in character cancellation are thin.
S5.4 states evaluation at 2^{4p}, four integer products, recovery by centered residues and time O(rp log(rp)).

The statement (error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, cost) and the route (two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise products, opposite procedure, scaling by M) match the paper. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) and the error accounting are not given.

The identity derivation is faithful: TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, N=CTD with ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}, left inverse with normalizations 2^{-2alpha^2}, then tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2. The approximations' cost O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), the axis-exposure cost and the explicit hypothesis theta>p/alpha^4 are not part of S6.1 (the separation appears only in S7.2).
Both identities are stated (QF_t u = abar.(a*(abar.u))/T, and the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2). The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined, and obtaining RF^+ by conjugation is absent.

Sizes b, p=6b, d, K, T, t_i, Tp=Theta(n), the prime window, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i>p are stated. The fixed rational exponents (tau, lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta) and eta=1/(4d) are missing; only kappa appears (S0, S9).
The isomorphism Phi:x->prod x_i^{mu_i}, implemented by triangular controlled shifts, is stated. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the triangular digit formula and the cost are missing.
The twist x_d->zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r} maps x_d^r-1 to y^r+1, so complex cyclic convolution is computed by ring convolution and an untwist; this matches the paper.

The source transform (A, chirp via ring convolution, B_0, 2^gamma, exact counterpart RF_s) and an outline of the steps are stated. The scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S, Phi^{-1}, and F^+ by conjugation are missing, and the six-step list is regrouped (see errors).

The final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, exact rounding and the carry recurrence with carries below 2^{2b} are stated, and the method follows the paper. The error chain E_ring, E_s=9.2^gamma TL, E_w<28.2^gamma T^2 L and the use of gamma<=b/4 are absent.

min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the absorption of log powers and the final bound O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) with a schoolbook cutoff are stated along the paper's route. The seven normalized costs and their margins g_1..g_7 are not listed.
S0 relies on the n log n conjecture and motivates the Theta(n log n) barrier. No step states that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes the eventual lower bound.

errors.says: motivation: 'the sum of these ranks is below $Wm$ times the number of wires'
errors.paper: The rank sum is less than the number of wires times m, i.e. s<Wm (lines 1352-1353, 1468); 'Wm times the number of wires' would be W^2 m.

errors.says: the total dimension change $s$ is strictly less than $Wm$ (and S2.3.2: L<N/2 so the rank budget is below Wm)
errors.paper: The total absolute dimension change is Wm-2N+2L (eq. rank-budget-labels), which is below Wm whenever L<N. The bit rank sum s_b=Wm-N+2L adds N source ranks, so s is not the dimension change and L<N/2 is needed only after that addition.

errors.says: motivation: 'Each edge needs a smaller interchange on a stream of volume V/W'
errors.paper: An edge of rational rank a needs exactly a smaller interchanges; the node makes s calls in all.

errors.says: The six steps are: form radix digits, apply Phi, two source transforms, multiply pointwise, apply the opposite transform and rescale, round and carry.
errors.paper: The six steps are: Phi; two source transforms; pointwise product with truncation; F^+ and scale by S; scale by 2^{2b+4}S, round and apply Phi^{-1}; carries. Forming digits is preparation, and Phi^{-1} is omitted in the plan.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: finite network (S2) -> fast chunk interchange (S3) -> simultaneous butterfly layer (S4) -> synthetic transforms and convolution (S5) -> resampling with retained permutations (S6) -> algorithm and exact recovery (S7-S8) -> cost table (S9). It thins out at the rank saving. The dimension budget Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and the ratios L/N=100/539, 101/539 are never given, and neither are the exponent tau=1-2^{-50} or the cost margins g_i; S2.3 also blurs the dimension change with s_b. Further down, the phase-frame mechanics (P_M conjugation, packed row additions) and the error chain are only asserted.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring scratch and the three-subset gadget are there, but not h=100, data indexed by triples in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3.
Common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and only edge operators D_vD_u^{-1} remain.
Nondegenerate tensor-product labels from triple indicators, nested on every edge, with the only decreasing edges central 3->4 each losing h. The ambient F^{tensor 3} of dimension m is implicit.

Only in motivations ('cost of an edge is the dimension of its orthogonal residual', 'projections turn label dimension changes into matrix ranks'). There is no rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and no explicit rank-one exception on the N source edges.
s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b is stated, but the dimension budget sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are absent, so the formula is not connected to the labels.
L<N/2 and s_b<W_bm are asserted, but the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 and the deficit N-2L>0 are not given. Graded conservatively, since the inequality is asserted without its supporting quantity.
Endpoint difference I_m on every role, and the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and edge rank a costs a smaller interchanges. The total of s calls per node is implied by the s/W factor in S3.2.4.
Children of volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^tau giving O(e^tau) are there, but tau=1-2^{-50} and its derivation from eta>20.2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent. Graded conservatively.

central.summary: The plan carries the architecture of the central saving: frames (C2), nested labels with only central edges losing h (C3), the endpoint identity I_m (C7) and rank-many interchanges per edge (C8). It does not reconstruct the arithmetic that makes the saving strict: no rank = dimension change, no budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, no L/N=100/539, and no tau=1-2^{-50}. So s<Wm and the exponent are asserted rather than reconstructed.
